BiblicalUsage: Jedidiah is the name Nathan the prophet gave to Solomon, because the LORD loved him. The child born to David and Bathsheba after the death of his brother was called Jedidiah, beloved of the LORD, and the name is the promise over his life.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God names His beloved, and the child born of grief was called beloved before he ever ruled. My position is that Solomon's second name is the truer one, and God loved him before he loved God.
